html:
switch-slider — preference toggle (pill track + knob)

~48 KB. Lazy artifact — mounts when a preference toggle renders; the CSS/WebGL toggle is the fallback.

 mountWebGpuWidget(SWITCH_SLIDER, canvas)
        │
        ▼
 SwitchSlider::init → gpu-mini scaffold (uniforms only)
        │
        ▼
 per frame: pill track SDF + knob sphere + per-context pattern:
   ECG waveform / blueprint grid / motion streaks

PIXEL-SPACE SHADER — the original canvas is a fixed 28px-tall control; all constants are raw px and do NOT scale. res must be the canvas's real CSS size and the canvas must match the design size, or the control renders wrong-sized.

  • set_state(progress, knob_x, context) — progress 0..1 toggle travel; context picks the pattern family.
  • UNIFORM_F32S = 12 — mirror table in lib.rs doc.
